title: Approved User / Trading Terminal Operator (Equity Derivatives)
description_plain:
Operate high-volume trading terminals in the equity derivatives segment of recognized Indian stock exchanges for a SEBI-registered trading member.

Statutory Regulatory Requirement for Approved Users:
- Pursuant to SEBI notification LAD-NRO/GN/2012-13/16/36422 and NISM Communiqué NISM/Certification/Series-VIII: ED/2012/01, associated persons functioning as approved users (terminal operators) and sales personnel of trading members in the equity derivatives segment must hold an active NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives) Certification prior to trading terminal deployment. (Note: Scoped specifically to approved users/sales personnel of trading members; US FINRA Series 7 is for US broker-dealer jurisdiction and does not apply).

mandatory_constraints: Active NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives) Certification for Approved Users (SEBI Mandated)
On-site presence at Mumbai trading member terminal
